item.title: LV Distribution Panel
item.description:
High-Quality LV Distribution Panel#

Designed for durability and safety, our distribution panels meet international standards (IEC 61439) and are widely used in industrial plants, commercial buildings, and infrastructure projects across Southeast Asia.

Key Specifications#

Parameter Value
Rated Voltage 400V / 690V AC
Current Rating Up to 6300A
Frequency 50/60 Hz
Protection Level IP54 / IP65 (Customizable)
Standards IEC 61439-1, IEC 61439-2
Enclosure Powder-coated steel / stainless steel
Busbar Copper, tin-plated
Short-circuit Withstand Up to 80kA

Features#

  • ✅ Modular design for easy expansion
  • ✅ High-quality copper busbars with tin plating
  • ✅ Powder-coated steel enclosure (RAL 7035 or custom)
  • ✅ Optional digital monitoring system (current, voltage, power)
  • ✅ Withdrawable MCCB / ACB options
  • ✅ Full type testing according to IEC 61439

Applications#

  • Industrial plants & factories
  • Commercial buildings & offices
  • Data centers
  • Water treatment facilities
  • Palm oil mills
  • Solar & renewable energy projects

What’s Included#

  • ✅ Factory routine test report
  • ✅ Wiring diagram & single-line diagram
  • ✅ Operation & maintenance manual
  • ✅ Spare parts list
  • ✅ Third-party inspection available on request

item.title: Motor Control Center (MCC)
item.description:
Motor Control Center (MCC)#

Our MCC panels provide centralized motor control and protection for industrial applications. Designed with modular drawers, each motor circuit is independently removable for maintenance without shutting down the entire system.

Key Specifications#

Parameter Value
Rated Voltage 400V / 690V AC
Motor Power Range 0.75kW – 355kW
Control Type DOL / Star-Delta / VFD / Soft Starter
Protection Level IP42 / IP54
Standards IEC 61439-1, IEC 60947
Withdrawable Drawers Yes (fixed + plug-in options)

Features#

  • ✅ Modular drawer design (fixed, plug-in, withdrawable)
  • ✅ VFD and soft starter integration
  • ✅ PLC/DCS communication (Modbus RTU/TCP, Profibus)
  • ✅ Motor protection relay with fault diagnosis
  • ✅ Emergency stop and interlocking functions

Applications#

  • Textile factories
  • Cement plants
  • Water treatment plants
  • Palm oil mills
  • Food & beverage processing
  • Chemical plants

📞 Need a customized MCC solution? Contact us via WhatsApp or send an inquiry.

item.title: Power Factor Correction Panel
item.description:
Power Factor Correction (PFC) Panel#

Our automatic PFC panels help industrial facilities reduce reactive power penalties and improve energy efficiency. Capable of maintaining power factor above 0.99.

Key Specifications#

Parameter Value
Rated Voltage 400V / 690V AC
Capacitor Bank 25 kVar – 1000 kVar
Switching Method Contactor / Thyristor
Target Power Factor 0.99
Protection Level IP40 / IP54
Standards IEC 60831, IEC 61439

Features#

  • ✅ Automatic switching based on real-time load
  • ✅ Thyristor-switched for fast response
  • ✅ Harmonic filter option (7th harmonic)
  • ✅ LCD display with power factor readout
  • ✅ Over-temperature and over-voltage protection

Applications#

  • Factories with inductive loads (motors, transformers)
  • Commercial buildings with central HVAC
  • Data centers
  • Steel mills & foundries

📞 Want to reduce your electricity bill? Contact us via WhatsApp or send an inquiry.

item.title: Electrical Control Cabinet
item.description:

Parameter Value

Control Voltage 24V DC / 110V AC / 220V AC
PLC Brand Siemens / Schneider / Mitsubishi / ABB
HMI Size 4.3" / 7" / 10.1" / 15"
Protection Level IP54 / IP65
Enclosure Powder-coated steel / Stainless steel 304/316
Standards IEC 61439, IEC 60204

Features#

  • ✅ PLC + HMI + VFD integrated design
  • ✅ Remote monitoring via Ethernet / 4G
